exposure: Surgical treatment of benign ovarian mucinous cystadenomas
cohort: 63 cases of benign ovarian mucinous cystadenomas (59 with complete data)
finding: In the presence of a benign or borderline unilateral ovarian mucinous tumour, especially if larger than 10-12 cm and with normal peritoneal and appendiceal gross morphology, appendectomy is not a necessary adjunctive procedure.
